name: Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin – Bookr
author: BS Software

sections.description:
Effortlessly manage your appointments with our powerful WordPress plugin, designed for businesses of all sizes. This intuitive tool allows users to book appointments directly through a customizable calendar displayed on your website.

Perfect for service-based businesses such as salons, clinics, consultants, and fitness trainers, this plugin simplifies your scheduling process while enhancing customer convenience.

BOOKR – Key Fetures

  • User-Friendly Booking System: Visitors can easily select available time slots and book appointments in just a few clicks.
  • Customizable Calendar: Tailor the calendar to match your brand’s style, including colors.
  • Client Management: Keep track of your clients and their booking history with an integrated customer database.
  • Email Notifications: Automatically send confirmation emails and reminders to clients and staff.
  • Mobile-Friendly Design: Ensure a seamless booking experience on any device.
  • Admin Controls: Manage appointments and adjust availability directly from your WordPress dashboard.

A Fresh Development with Community-Driven Innovation

This plugin is a brand-new development aimed at redefining online appointment booking and calendar management. We’re committed to collaborating closely with a vibrant community to identify and implement the most sought-after features. Together, we strive to create a tool that meets real-world needs while continuously evolving based on your feedback and ideas. Join us in shaping the future of seamless scheduling!
